diagnostics.message: resource.aws_lambda_function.main can be created with vpc_config (when subnet_ids/security_group_ids are provided), which requires the execution role to already have the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole permissions at CreateFunction time (ENI creation permission is validated by Lambda). aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.vpc_execution_role currently only shares aws_iam_role.main as a common dependency, so Terraform may create the function before the policy is attached, causing VPC-enabled function creation to fail intermittently. Add an explicit depends_on from the function to the attachment.
